mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS <= 0.1%) compresses the discount rate applied to equity cash flows, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS <= 0.1% (based on 3-year rolling window analysis).

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL index level above 230 indicates persistent inflationary pressures, prompting the Federal Reserve to anticipate monetary tightening, which reduces equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 230 (based on 3-year rolling window analysis).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high unemployment (UNRATE > 7.5%) and low payroll employment (PAYEMS < 136000 thousand) signals a deteriorating labor market, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 7.5 and PAYEMS < 136000 (based on 3-year rolling window analysis).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, strong housing starts (HOUST > 900 thousand) indicate sustained consumer demand and economic growth, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances during late-cycle expansions when HOUST > 900 thousand (based on 3-year rolling window analysis).

mechanism_narrative: A strong industrial production level (INDPRO > 98.5) indicates robust manufacturing and supply chain activity, supporting corporate earnings and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO > 98.5 (based on 3-year rolling window analysis).

mechanism_narrative: A UNRATE above 7.8% signals a deteriorating labor market, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 7.8 (based on 3-year rolling window analysis).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strength in housing starts (HOUST > 900 thousand) and retail sales (RSAFS > 420000 million dollars) signals robust consumer demand, which supports corporate earnings and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST > 900 and RSAFS > 420000 (based on 3-year rolling window analysis).

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses the equity risk premium and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances during monetary tightening cycles (based on 3-year rolling window analysis).
